title: Billing
content:
Billing
Billing manages your BookingTours subscription — your plan, seats, and payment history. (Customer invoices live on the Invoices page; this is what you pay, not what customers pay.) Visible to MAIN_ADMIN and above.

title: Billing — Your plan
content:
Billing — Your plan
## Your plan

The plan card shows your plan name, base price plus per-seat price, seats purchased versus admins actually active, this month's total, billing cycle, and status (Active, Paused, Cancelled, Suspended, or Trial).

title: How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes)
content:
How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes)
A quick reference for the booking lifecycle across the whole dashboard.

title: How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Booking statuses
content:
How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Booking statuses
## Booking statuses

- **Held / Pending** — seats reserved, payment not yet received. Online checkouts hold seats for about 15 minutes; manual bookings hold for the duration you set (default 24 hours). Unpaid holds release automatically.
- **Paid** — payment confirmed (card payment webhook, or marked paid manually for EFT/cash).
- **Confirmed** — confirmed to run.
- **Completed** — the trip happened.
- **Cancelled** — cancelled by you or the customer; seats returned to the slot.

title: How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — How online payment works
content:
How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — How online payment works
## How online payment works

At checkout the customer gets a secure card-payment page. Payment confirmation arrives from the payment provider and flips the booking to PAID automatically — you don't need to do anything. If a customer pays by EFT, mark the booking paid yourself on the Bookings page.

title: How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Customer self-service
content:
How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Customer self-service
## Customer self-service

Customers manage their own bookings at your booking site's My Bookings page, logging in with a one-time email code. They can view bookings, reschedule, and request cancellations there — those requests flow into your dashboard.

title: Bookings
content:
Bookings
The Bookings page is the master ledger of every booking, grouped by day and slot.

title: Bookings — Filtering and finding a booking
content:
Bookings — Filtering and finding a booking
## Filtering and finding a booking

Use the status filter across the top: **Pending, Paid, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled** — each shows a live count. The Pending bucket includes bookings still awaiting payment and temporary holds. Use the search box to find a booking by customer name, email, or phone. Day and slot sections expand and collapse.

title: Billing — Pausing for the off-season
content:
Billing — Pausing for the off-season
## Pausing for the off-season

**Pause for off-season** stops normal billing and trading. The current sign-in gate shows **Your account is paused** and blocks normal dashboard pages; a MAIN_ADMIN can follow **Go to Billing** and use **Resume now**. Staff should ask their main admin to resume the subscription. Do not assume all dashboard pages remain readable during a pause.

title: Billing — Plan changes and suspension
content:
Billing — Plan changes and suspension
## Plan changes and suspension

If more than one plan is offered, use **Change plan** and review the new included seats and proration before confirming. The plan card shows the actual configured rates. A suspended account also blocks normal dashboard access; its main admin can reach Billing, but operational suspension may need BookingTours support to resolve. Paying an invoice does not by itself guarantee that an operational suspension is lifted.

title: How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Guest count changes
content:
How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Guest count changes
## Guest count changes

Increasing guests on a paid booking reserves extra seats pending payment and can require new waiver information. Decreasing guests releases capacity and handles any excess value through the available voucher/refund options. An unpaid booking is repriced without returning money that was never received.

title: How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Cancellations and refunds
content:
How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Cancellations and refunds
## Cancellations and refunds

Cancelling a booking releases its reserved seats. Customer cancellations follow the configured time-based policy. Operator/weather cancellation can offer eligible paid guests reschedule, voucher or refund choices. Voucher-funded value is returned as voucher credit rather than a card refund. See [Refunds](/refunds) for requested refunds and pending provider outcomes; submitting a refund is not the same as completing one.

title: Customers — What it shows
content:
Customers — What it shows
## What it shows

Header cards give your **total customer count** and how many are **opted in** to marketing. The table lists name, email, phone, number of trips, total spent, last trip date, and marketing consent. Search by name, email, or phone.

title: Dashboard home — Today's numbers
content:
Dashboard home — Today's numbers
## Today's numbers

The hero band shows **Today's Pax** (total passengers booked today — click it to open Bookings) and a **Revenue** card with today, last-7-days, and this-month totals plus a daily sparkline (click through to Reports for detail). All figures are in your business's timezone.

title: Inbox — Finding a conversation
content:
Inbox — Finding a conversation
## Finding a conversation

Search by name, phone number, or email. Conversations needing attention sort first, then by recency. Opening the Inbox from a booking's WhatsApp action jumps straight to that customer.

title: Invoices — Browsing and printing
content:
Invoices — Browsing and printing
## Browsing and printing

Invoices are grouped by day; filter by date to find a specific one. Each invoice can be **printed or saved as PDF** (a print-ready document opens) or downloaded as HTML. Invoice numbers are assigned automatically and stay stable once generated.

title: Marketing
content:
Marketing
Marketing is your email-marketing hub: contacts, templates, campaigns, automations, and promotions, with an analytics overview.

title: Bookings — Cancelling a paid booking
content:
Bookings — Cancelling a paid booking
## Cancelling a paid booking

Cancelling a paid booking releases the seats back to the slot and emails the customer so **they choose** how to handle it: reschedule, voucher, or full refund (managed from their My Bookings page) — the same workflow as an operator/weather cancellation.

**Within 24 hours of the trip start** the booking is forfeited instead: the customer is notified but gets no refund options. When you cancel inside that window, the confirm dialog lets you override this and still offer the reschedule/voucher/refund choice — use it for goodwill cases.

Voucher-paid bookings are the exception: cancelling one re-issues a voucher for the full amount rather than offering the three options.

title: Broadcasts — Weather Mode — cancelling slots
content:
Broadcasts — Weather Mode — cancelling slots
## Weather Mode — cancelling slots

MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN can use **Weather Mode** to cancel selected departures through the cancellation service. Affected bookings are cancelled and notification attempts offer eligible paid guests **reschedule, voucher or refund** choices. No refund completes merely because the slots were cancelled. Operations staff should ask their main admin to perform the cancellation. Sending a normal broadcast does not cancel bookings.

title: Marketing — Contacts
content:
Marketing — Contacts
## Contacts

Use the **Contacts** tab to manage your audience. **Templates**, **Automations**, **Promos** and **Vouchers** are the other tabs in Marketing. Automatic tag rules in Settings can segment contacts based on booking behaviour. Campaign sending requires eligible active contacts with marketing consent; unsubscribed contacts are excluded.

title: Marketing — Promotions
content:
Marketing — Promotions
## Promotions

Marketing → Promotions manages promo codes that customers can apply at checkout and that you can apply on manual bookings.

title: Guide access and the Guide app — Existing Guide app access
content:
Guide access and the Guide app — Existing Guide app access
## Existing Guide app access

Any dashboard account (OPERATOR role or above) can use the Guide app. Add it to the phone's home screen for app-like access — it works as a PWA.

title: Dashboard home — Simple View
content:
Dashboard home — Simple View
## Simple View

Choose **Simple View** in the dashboard header for the phone and tablet workflow. [Today](/simple) and [Calendar](/simple/calendar) show booked sessions and their roll calls. [Check-ins](/simple/check-ins) records offline payments and partial group arrivals. **Full dashboard** brings you back here.

For guides who only need passenger totals and trip photos, the main admin creates a shared guide login under [Settings → Admin Users → Guide login](/settings#admins). It opens the restricted guide version of Simple View directly.

title: Broadcasts
content:
Broadcasts
Broadcasts sends a message to every guest booked on the slots you select — by WhatsApp and email at once. It's the fastest way to reach "everyone on tomorrow's 9am".

title: Broadcasts — History
content:
Broadcasts — History
## History

The history list shows past sends, marked BC for normal broadcasts and WX for weather cancellations.

title: Customers — What it's for
content:
Customers — What it's for
## What it's for

It's informational — there are no edit actions here. To email customers, use Marketing (contacts are managed there); to message an individual, find their booking and use the WhatsApp action, or search for them in the Inbox.

title: Inbox — Replying
content:
Inbox — Replying
## Replying

Select a conversation to see the full thread — bot, customer, and admin messages are visually distinct, grouped by day, and update in real time. Type your reply and send; it goes out on the same channel the customer used (WhatsApp or web chat).

title: Inbox — WhatsApp not configured?
content:
Inbox — WhatsApp not configured?
## WhatsApp not configured?

If replies fail with a credentials message, your WhatsApp integration isn't set up. A MAIN_ADMIN can add the WhatsApp token and phone number ID under Settings → Integration Credentials.

title: Finding your way around
content:
Finding your way around
The dashboard sidebar is organised into groups. Click a group label to collapse or expand it — the dashboard remembers your layout.

title: Bookings — Bulk actions
content:
Bookings — Bulk actions
## Bulk actions

Tick multiple bookings and a sticky action bar appears:

- **Check in** — for eligible paid bookings; payment and waiver checks still apply when saving arrivals.
- **Mark paid (EFT)** — only when all selected are unpaid.
- **Cancel** — when none are already cancelled.
- **Refund** — when all selected are paid.

Bulk runs show per-row progress so you can see exactly which succeeded.

title: Dashboard home — Action cards
content:
Dashboard home — Action cards
## Action cards

Three cards surface work needing attention, each linking to the right page:

- **Pending Refunds** — count and total value of refund requests waiting for a decision. Click to open the Refund Queue.
- **Inbox Action** — conversations where a customer is waiting for a human reply. Click to open the Inbox.
- **Photo upload backlog** — booked trips from the last 7 days with no saved photo links. Click to open Trip Photos. Saving links and sending them to guests are separate steps; this count is not proof that a photo email was delivered.

title: Invoices — Company details on invoices
content:
Invoices — Company details on invoices
## Company details on invoices

Company and EFT banking details come from [Invoice & Banking Details](/settings#invoice). A MAIN_ADMIN can manage both. Staff granted **Invoice Details** can edit the permitted company fields; banking details still require MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.

title: Finding your way around — The sidebar collapsed to icons
content:
Finding your way around — The sidebar collapsed to icons
## The sidebar collapsed to icons

On desktop, use the collapse control beside the business name at the top of the sidebar to switch to an icon rail. On phones and tablets, use the bottom Dashboard, Bookings, New Booking and Inbox navigation, and **More** for the remaining pages.

The help assistant is opened from **AI help** in the dashboard header. In the shared demo the control is named **AI bot**. The assistant explains the product and can open pages; it does not read your bookings or account totals.

title: Guide access and the Guide app — Check-ins and the office
content:
Guide access and the Guide app — Check-ins and the office
## Check-ins and the office

Saved check-ins update the main dashboard so the office sees who arrived. Offline operations can be queued, but must sync and pass the server's current checks; a queued local change is not confirmation that the office has received it. If a queued update conflicts with newer data, review the current count before retrying.

title: Guide access and the Guide app
content:
Guide access and the Guide app
For guides who need client contacts, check-ins and trip photos, use the operator's **shared guide login**, which opens [Guide Simple View](/simpleguide) directly. The existing [Guide app](/guide) is a separate check-in workflow for dashboard staff; it is not the destination for a shared guide login.

title: Customers
content:
Customers
The Customers page (at /customers — reached by link, it's not in the sidebar) is a read-only directory of everyone who has booked with you, ranked by lifetime trips.

title: Dashboard home
content:
Dashboard home
The Dashboard is your at-a-glance cockpit for today: passengers, revenue, and anything needing attention.

title: Inbox
content:
Inbox
The Inbox is the unified conversation console for WhatsApp and website chat. The AI assistant answers routine questions automatically; conversations that need a human float to the top with a "Needs reply" pill.

title: Invoices
content:
Invoices
The Invoices page holds the pro forma invoices generated for customer bookings. This is customer paperwork — for your own BookingTours subscription billing, see the Billing page.

title: Invoices — Resending an invoice
content:
Invoices — Resending an invoice
## Resending an invoice

To resend an invoice to a customer, use the resend action on the booking itself on the Bookings page.

title: New Booking
content:
New Booking
New Booking creates a booking on behalf of a customer — walk-ins, phone bookings, or corporate groups.

title: Inbox — The WhatsApp 24-hour window
content:
Inbox — The WhatsApp 24-hour window
## The WhatsApp 24-hour window

WhatsApp only allows businesses to send free-form messages within 24 hours of the customer's last message. This is a WhatsApp platform rule, not a BookingTours limitation.

If the window has closed, your message isn't lost: the system automatically sends the customer a pre-approved "please reply" template, and your message is queued (marked with ⏳ in the thread). The moment they reply, the queued message is delivered and the window reopens — from then on you can chat live in the Inbox as normal.

title: Dashboard home — Manifest and roll call
content:
Dashboard home — Manifest and roll call
## Manifest and roll call

The **Manifest** panel lists departures and passenger totals for today or tomorrow using the Today/Tomorrow toggle. Select a departure to show its guests in **Roll Call**. The next-departure summary helps you see what is coming up.

Roll Call shows arrivals as a count out of the booking's group size, including partial arrivals. Check-in still requires the booking to meet the payment and waiver checks. For entering a specific arrival count, use [Simple View Check-ins](/simple/check-ins). Use **Add Booking** for a walk-in.

title: Marketing — The overview page
content:
Marketing — The overview page
## The overview page

The landing page shows Active Contacts, Templates, Emails Sent, and Campaigns, an **Email Usage This Month** meter (emails sent versus your plan's included quota, with overage cost projection), and charts for engagement (open, click, unsubscribe, bounce rates), campaign performance, audience breakdown, and open-rate trend.

title: Finding your way around — Integrations that are not available yet
content:
Finding your way around — Integrations that are not available yet
## Integrations that are not available yet

Direct Viator and GetYourGuide connections are not available yet. Settings shows this status; /settings/ota and /ota-drift are not available operational pages. ChatGPT/MCP and Meta Muse operator connections are not customer-available either. Do not treat locally developed connection screens as a working live integration.

title: Guide access and the Guide app — Existing Guide app for dashboard staff
content:
Guide access and the Guide app — Existing Guide app for dashboard staff
## Existing Guide app for dashboard staff

Pick a date to see departures, guest and booking counts, and capacity. Tap a slot for its passenger list, customer notes, waiver status and arrival counts. **Check in** marks an eligible group present; **Check in rest** marks the remaining members of a partially arrived group. Payment and waiver checks apply. For entering or correcting a specific partial count, use [Simple View Check-ins](/simple/check-ins). Trip photos has its own link from the departure screen.

title: New Booking — Discounts and promo codes
content:
New Booking — Discounts and promo codes
## Discounts and promo codes

Under **Price Adjustment** you can apply:

- **Manual discount** — reduce the price by an amount; a reason is required and recorded against the booking.
- **Promo code** — validated live; supports percentage or fixed-amount codes.

Add-on revenue is preserved even when a manual discount is applied — the discount applies to the tour price.

title: Failed Notifications — Common failure causes
content:
Failed Notifications — Common failure causes
## Common failure causes

The customer's number not being on WhatsApp, the 24-hour messaging window being closed with no approved template available, or WhatsApp credentials being missing or expired (check Settings → Integration Credentials). When WhatsApp fails permanently, important messages fall back to email where possible.

title: Operators — Switching operator
content:
Operators — Switching operator
## Switching operator

If your account has access to multiple operators, each is listed with a **Switch** button. Switching re-scopes the entire dashboard — bookings, refunds, pricing, reports, media — to the chosen operator. If you only have one operator, it shows as locked and there's nothing to switch.

title: Operators — Data isolation
content:
Operators — Data isolation
## Data isolation

Each operator's data is fully isolated. Switching context is the only way to see another operator's bookings, and only if your account has been granted access to that operator.

title: Peak Pricing
content:
Peak Pricing
Peak Pricing manages what each tour costs, including seasonal (peak) rates.

title: Peak Pricing — Base and peak rates
content:
Peak Pricing — Base and peak rates
## Base and peak rates

The tour rate table shows each tour's **base price** and **peak price** — edit and save directly. The peak price is what applies during peak periods.

title: Peak Pricing — What gets skipped (grandfathering)
content:
Peak Pricing — What gets skipped (grandfathering)
## What gets skipped (grandfathering)

Slots you've manually re-priced, and slots that already have paid or confirmed bookings, are **not** changed by a peak rule — existing customers keep the price they booked at.

title: Peak Pricing — Removing a peak period
content:
Peak Pricing — Removing a peak period
## Removing a peak period

Remove a rule from the **Peak Period Rules** list; affected slots revert to the base price (with the same grandfathering protections).

title: Failed Notifications
content:
Failed Notifications
Open [Broadcasts](/broadcasts), then the **Failed Notifications** tab at /notifications. MAIN_ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN can inspect both WhatsApp outbox messages and transactional email jobs here.

title: Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Sending a payment reminder
content:
Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Sending a payment reminder
## Sending a payment reminder

Find the unpaid booking and open its action menu. **Payment Reminder** resends its existing checkout link. If that action is unavailable because no link exists, use **Payment Link** first. Verify the reported result before assuming a message was delivered.

title: Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Deadlines and automatic reminders
content:
Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Deadlines and automatic reminders
## Deadlines and automatic reminders

Manual bookings use the payment deadline set by **Hold booking for** in New Booking. Online checkout holds have a shorter expiry. Scheduled reminder and pre-trip auto-cancel behaviour depends on the business's automation configuration; the current dashboard does not expose a separate global reminder settings page. Ask BookingTours support if that configuration needs changing.

title: Trip Photos
content:
Trip Photos
Trip Photos prepares and shares a trip's photos and videos with its lead bookers. Reach [Trip Photos](/photos) from the Dashboard's **Photo upload backlog** card or open /photos directly.

title: New Booking — Price unavailable
content:
New Booking — Price unavailable
## Price unavailable

A missing, negative or invalid configured tour/departure price blocks booking creation and shows **Price unavailable**. Ask an admin to correct the configured pricing, then refresh. Do not treat missing pricing as a free booking.

title: Operators
content:
Operators
The Operators page (at /operators) controls which business your dashboard is currently showing, for admins who manage more than one operator.

title: Peak Pricing — Setting a peak period
content:
Peak Pricing — Setting a peak period
## Setting a peak period

**Set Peak Period** creates a seasonal rule: a date range, a label, per-tour peak prices, and a **priority**. Existing slots in the range get flagged as peak with the override price; slots created later inside the range pick the rule up automatically. If two periods overlap, the higher priority wins — the page warns you about overlaps.

title: Refunds
content:
Refunds
The Refund Queue lists customer refund requests waiting for your decision, with the pending count and total value at the top.

title: Reports
content:
Reports
Reports gives you filterable, exportable views of your operation for bookkeeping, tax, and planning.

title: Reviews — Where reviews come from
content:
Reviews — Where reviews come from
## Where reviews come from

Reviews arrive from customer review requests (sent automatically after trips by the auto-message system) and other configured sources such as Google reviews, which sync daily.

title: Slots
content:
Slots
Slots are your bookable departures: a tour at a time on a date with a capacity and price. Customers can only book where an OPEN slot exists.

title: Failed Notifications — The tabs
content:
Failed Notifications — The tabs
## The tabs

- **Failed** — failed or expired messages. Each row shows the destination, channel, message type, attempts, error and expandable message body.
- **Waiting for window** — messages queued until WhatsApp's 24-hour window reopens (they send automatically once the customer messages in or a template becomes applicable).
- **Recent sent** — recently delivered messages, for confirmation.

title: Payment reminders and unpaid bookings
content:
Payment reminders and unpaid bookings
Payment reminders are managed through actions on [Bookings](/bookings). There is no separate /payment-reminders dashboard page.

title: Trip Photos — Recent photo links
content:
Trip Photos — Recent photo links
## Recent photo links

**Recent Photo Links** shows saved galleries and folders. A saved link is available for review and guest access; it does not prove an email or WhatsApp notification was delivered. A MAIN_ADMIN connects Google Drive under [Integration Credentials](/settings#credentials).

title: Refunds — Submitting the queue
content:
Refunds — Submitting the queue
## Submitting the queue

**Submit All** attempts queued refunds one at a time and records the result of each. Keep the page open until submission finishes. Card refunds can remain pending and bank transfers still need manual handling. Leaving the page or changing operator stops further submissions; a batch is not proof that every refund completed.

title: Settings — Dashboard Preferences
content:
Settings — Dashboard Preferences
## Dashboard Preferences

Show or hide **Help assistant bubble** for your own admin account. This preference follows your account across devices and does not change another staff member's preference or disable the customer chatbot. In the current dashboard, the assistant opens from the header's AI help control.

title: Slots — Editing a slot
content:
Slots — Editing a slot
## Editing a slot

The **Edit Slot** modal changes time, capacity, or price. It deliberately does not change status — opening, closing, and cancelling are separate actions so a price edit can never accidentally cancel a departure.

title: Settings — Booking Site Configuration
content:
Settings — Booking Site Configuration
## Booking Site Configuration

Your customer-facing booking site's policies, directions, branding, background and hero text, navigation, button and footer copy, theme colours, contact links, timezone, chatbot avatar and cancellation policy tiers. The booking-site preview shows the effect of the settings, including theme text contrast. Custom checkout questions are maintained under Tours & Activities.

title: Settings — Email Customisation
content:
Settings — Email Customisation
## Email Customisation

Per-email-type colour themes and banner images for the emails customers receive (confirmations, invoices, cancellations, photos, and so on).

title: Refunds — History
content:
Refunds — History
## History

Expand **Processed Refunds** to see recent completed, failed, and declined refunds.

title: Settings
content:
Settings
Settings is one page of collapsible sections covering your whole configuration. It's visible to MAIN_ADMIN and above — though a MAIN_ADMIN can grant a regular admin access to specific sections (per-section settings permissions), in which case that admin sees only their granted sections.

title: Vouchers — Finding a voucher
content:
Vouchers — Finding a voucher
## Finding a voucher

The list is grouped by creation date, with filters for date and status plus free-text search — search by code when a customer calls to redeem or asks about their gift.

title: WhatsApp and automatic messages — The WhatsApp 24-hour rule
content:
WhatsApp and automatic messages — The WhatsApp 24-hour rule
## The WhatsApp 24-hour rule

WhatsApp allows free-form business messages only within 24 hours of the customer's last message. Outside that window, only pre-approved templates can be sent; other messages queue as "waiting for window" and send once the customer messages in. This is a WhatsApp platform rule that applies to every business.

title: Reports — Report tabs
content:
Reports — Report tabs
## Report tabs

- **Bookings** — booking volumes and details.
- **Financials** — accounting view: gross booked, amount actually received, refunds, net received, and outstanding balances, with a per-booking payment method and payment reference.
- **Marketing** — email performance.
- **Attendance** — who showed up.
- **Waivers** — waiver completion.
- **Reviews** — moderate customer reviews by status. This uses the same Reports navigation, with **Pending**, **Approved**, **Hidden**, and **Spam** filters.

title: Settings — Embed Widget
content:
Settings — Embed Widget
## Embed Widget

A copyable snippet to embed your booking widget on your own website.

title: Refunds — What appears here
content:
Refunds — What appears here
## What appears here

The queue includes requested refunds, failed attempts, pending provider refunds and refunds requiring a bank transfer. A cancellation awaiting the customer's choice of refund, voucher or reschedule is not yet a refund request. That booking remains action required until they choose.

title: Reviews
content:
Reviews
Open [Reports](/reports), then its **Reviews** tab at /reviews to moderate customer reviews before they appear publicly. Your main admin can hide Reviews for individual staff. Reviews is excluded from the shared demo.

title: Settings — Automation Tag Rules
content:
Settings — Automation Tag Rules
## Automation Tag Rules

Rules that automatically tag marketing contacts based on booking behaviour (for example tag customers who booked a specific tour), for targeting campaigns.

title: Slots — Creating slots
content:
Slots — Creating slots
## Creating slots

Open [Slots](/slots) and choose **Add Slot**. The **Add New Slots** dialog asks for the tour, start time, one or more date ranges, capacity and an optional price override. Blank price uses the tour default. Existing departures at the same tour and time are skipped rather than duplicated.

For repeating schedules choose **Bulk Generate**: select one or more tours, date ranges, departure times, weekdays and capacity. Review the per-tour overrides and preview before generating. Results show created slots, skipped duplicates and errors for each tour.

title: Super Admin
content:
Super Admin
Super Admin is your platform control room. It can access every business. Never give this role to a client.

title: Vouchers
content:
Vouchers
Open [Marketing](/marketing), then the **Vouchers** tab at /vouchers. Vouchers cover gifts, credits and tour redemption. Each has a code the customer uses when booking with your business. The create form generates an 8-character code and lets you regenerate or edit it.

title: Settings — Operations & AI Configuration
content:
Settings — Operations & AI Configuration
## Operations & AI Configuration

Arrival instructions, what to bring and wear, FAQ answers, and the AI chatbot's personality and business knowledge. This content feeds the customer website and WhatsApp assistant; arrival and packing instructions also feed guest emails. It does not change the dashboard help assistant's product guide. Staff with the **Booking Site Config** grant can also manage this section and Embed Widget.

title: Reviews — Moderating
content:
Reviews — Moderating
## Moderating

Filter by status: **Pending** (submitted, awaiting moderation), **Approved**, **Hidden**, and **Spam**. Each review shows its source, star rating, comment, reviewer, and tour. Use **Approve** to publish, **Hide** to remove from public view, or **Spam** to mark junk. Acting on a review moves it out of the current filter view.

title: WhatsApp and automatic messages
content:
WhatsApp and automatic messages
BookingTours messages your customers automatically at the right moments — this explains what goes out, when, and the WhatsApp rules that govern it.

title: WhatsApp and automatic messages — The WhatsApp bot
content:
WhatsApp and automatic messages — The WhatsApp bot
## The WhatsApp bot

The AI assistant can answer customer WhatsApp messages automatically — controlled by the WhatsApp Bot Mode section in Settings (always, outside business hours, or never). Conversations the bot can't handle land in your Inbox marked as needing a reply.

title: Reports — Financials for accounting
content:
Reports — Financials for accounting
## Financials for accounting

The Financials tab reconciles money movement, not just booked totals: **Gross Booked** (what live bookings owe), **Received** (cash and voucher value actually captured), **Refunded** (processed refunds), **Net Received**, and **Outstanding** (due but unpaid). Payments received with no gateway reference are flagged for audit. The Financials CSV is a full transaction ledger with every money column, payment references, voucher and promo details, OTA amounts, refund history, cancellation details and who took the booking.

title: Slots — Calendar views
content:
Slots — Calendar views
## Calendar views

Switch between **Week** and **Day**, use the arrows or date picker, or choose **Month** to open the monthly booking overview. Month helps you jump to a date; slot editing happens in the day or week calendar.

title: Refunds — Where refund amounts come from
content:
Refunds — Where refund amounts come from
## Where refund amounts come from

Refund amounts follow the configured cancellation tiers and remaining captured balance. Weather cancellation offers eligible paid guests a full refund, voucher or reschedule; the guest chooses first. Voucher-funded amounts return as voucher credit rather than a card refund. Mixed payments are handled according to their paid portions.

title: Settings — WhatsApp Bot Mode
content:
Settings — WhatsApp Bot Mode
## WhatsApp Bot Mode

Controls WhatsApp auto-replies: **Always**, **Outside business hours**, or **Never**. Outside-hours mode uses the saved weekly schedule and business timezone. Human takeover on an individual conversation still takes precedence. This section requires a main admin; ordinary Settings grants do not unlock it.

title: Slots — Bulk edit
content:
Slots — Bulk edit
## Bulk edit

Choose **Bulk Edit** to open **Bulk Edit Slots**. Apply a new capacity, price and/or time across a date range for one tour or all tours. Blank fields keep their existing values; enter **NULL** in the price field to reset to the tour default. Editing time, capacity or price does not cancel bookings.

title: Vouchers — Creating a voucher
content:
Vouchers — Creating a voucher
## Creating a voucher

Fill in the recipient and buyer details, choose the tour, and pick the type:

- **Gift** — bought by one person for another, with an optional gift message.
- **Credit** — a monetary amount the recipient can spend on a booking.
- **Free Trip** — a voucher for tour redemption. The dashboard create form still sells it by payment link; selecting this type does not grant unpaid complimentary credit.

Enter a positive rand value and a buyer email, choose the type, and review the buyer, recipient, tour and optional gift message. **Send payment link** emails the buyer a checkout link. Every voucher sold through this form remains PENDING until payment is confirmed. Expiry is set to three years automatically, and the list shows its date.

Recipient email is optional and controls gift delivery. Credit vouchers arising from cancellations or booking changes are a separate recovery flow; creating an order here does not complete a refund.

title: Settings — Booking Add-Ons
content:
Settings — Booking Add-Ons
## Booking Add-Ons

Optional extras customers can add at checkout (photo packages, equipment hire). Create, edit, and drag-reorder.

title: Vouchers — Voucher statuses
content:
Vouchers — Voucher statuses
## Voucher statuses

- **Pending** — created but not yet paid for.
- **Active** — paid and ready to redeem.
- **Redeemed** — used on a booking.
- **Expired** — past its expiry date.

The status tiles at the top show counts for each.

title: Settings — Admin Users
content:
Settings — Admin Users
## Admin Users

Add dashboard users (they receive a password-setup email), resend setup links, remove admins, and grant per-section settings permissions. The Main Admin account can't be deleted. This section also lets you suspend or reactivate the subscription.

The **Billing contact** selector chooses who receives BookingTours subscription invoices. By default they go to the first admin created on the account; pick any other admin to redirect them.

title: AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — Updating what the guest bot knows
content:
AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — Updating what the guest bot knows
## Updating what the guest bot knows

Use [Chat FAQ](/settings/chat-faq) for enabled keyword/intent rules and exact approved replies. Use [Operations & AI Configuration](/settings#operations) for FAQs, guest arrival/packing instructions and the chatbot's personality and business knowledge. Those settings feed the customer website and WhatsApp bot, not the dashboard help assistant.

title: Billing — History and payment method
content:
Billing — History and payment method
## History and payment method

Your payment method on file and billing history are at the bottom of the page.

title: Broadcasts — Sending a broadcast
content:
Broadcasts — Sending a broadcast
## Sending a broadcast

1. Pick a date on the calendar (days with slots are highlighted, with booked-guest counts).
2. Tick the slots you want, or Select All. A summary shows how many customers will be notified.
3. Compose your message — use the {name} tag to personalise with the guest's name.
4. Send. The result reports how many were delivered per channel, with a failure breakdown.

WhatsApp delivery depends on the customer's number, credentials and service window. Where configured, a pre-approved reply-request template can reopen the conversation and queued text can send after the customer responds. Email is attempted for guests with an email address. Check the returned per-channel results and failures; a send attempt does not guarantee everyone received the notice.

title: Customer privacy data requests — Confirmation and review
content:
Customer privacy data requests — Confirmation and review
## Confirmation and review

Requests are grouped by their status, including those awaiting customer confirmation, actionable requests and completed history. Pending requests need the customer's email confirmation before actions become available. Use the request's dates and status to determine the next available action.

title: Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Letting a specific booking through
content:
Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Letting a specific booking through
## Letting a specific booking through

For an approved pay-on-arrival or invoice arrangement, use **Allow Without Payment** on the booking. It is excluded from reminders and automatic expiry, and its seats stay reserved. **Require Payment** restores the normal rules. This exception does not record a payment or bypass check-in eligibility; confirm the actual payment before checking in.

title: Slots — Hidden slots
content:
Slots — Hidden slots
## Hidden slots

By default, CLOSED and zero-capacity slots are hidden from the list. Use the "Show closed / 0-capacity" toggle to reveal them.

title: WhatsApp and automatic messages — What's sent automatically
content:
WhatsApp and automatic messages — What's sent automatically
## What's sent automatically

- **Booking confirmation** — on successful payment, with the invoice.
- **Payment link follow-up** — if an online checkout was started but not paid, the customer is emailed their payment link after the hold lapses.
- **Trip reminders** — before the trip, WhatsApp-first with waiver links bundled where applicable, falling back to email.
- **Review requests** — after the trip.
- **Cancellation notices** — when you cancel slots (weather or otherwise), with self-service reschedule/voucher/refund options.

Automatic jobs track sent messages and retries to avoid duplicate scheduled delivery. A queued job or successful submission is not proof of delivery; failed WhatsApp and transactional email jobs can be inspected in [Broadcasts → Failed Notifications](/notifications) by a main admin. Trip timing uses your business timezone.

title: WhatsApp and automatic messages — When WhatsApp fails
content:
WhatsApp and automatic messages — When WhatsApp fails
## When WhatsApp fails

The Failed Notifications tab under Broadcasts tracks WhatsApp failures and transactional email jobs. Important workflows can fall back to email where configured and valid contact details exist. Review the returned outcome and failure log rather than assuming every guest was reached.

title: Reports — Accounting registers
content:
Reports — Accounting registers
## Accounting registers

On the Financials tab you can also export four registers for your accountant or an audit:

- **Refunds CSV** — every processed refund in the period with amounts, reasons and payment references.
- **Invoices CSV** — the invoice register in invoice-number order, with VAT numbers, payment method and reference per invoice.
- **Vouchers CSV** — vouchers sold in the period, vouchers redeemed in the period, and the open voucher balance (your outstanding liability).
- **Combo Settlements CSV** — amounts payable to and receivable from partner operators on combo bookings.

title: Chat FAQ (Quick Answers) — Who can manage Quick Answers
content:
Chat FAQ (Quick Answers) — Who can manage Quick Answers
## Who can manage Quick Answers

Only a main admin can open this page. Operations admins who spot a wrong bot answer should tell their main admin what to change.

title: AI usage and customer chatbot allowance
content:
AI usage and customer chatbot allowance
Open **AI** in the Growth group, then the **AI Usage** tab. MAIN_ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN can view customer chatbot usage and open the **Chat FAQ** tab from here.

title: AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — Replies, allowance and overage
content:
AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — Replies, allowance and overage
## Replies, allowance and overage

The page shows this month's billable **Replies**, **Balance**, **Allowance used**, **Overage** and **Cache hits**, plus activity by surface. It refreshes every 30 seconds. The included reply allowance and per-reply overage rate come from your business's current configuration; read the displayed values instead of assuming every operator has the same plan or rate.

Customer WhatsApp and website AI replies count toward the allowance. Dashboard **Admin help chat**, intent/date parsing and shadow activity are labelled not billed. Quick Answers and the dashboard product guide are separate from each other.

title: AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — When the included allowance is used
content:
AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — When the included allowance is used
## When the included allowance is used

The customer assistant can continue beyond its included replies at the displayed overage rate, until the configured hard ceiling shown on the page. At that ceiling, AI replies pause; existing bookings, reminders and payments are unaffected. Contact BookingTours to discuss an allowance change. Usage belongs in the platform subscription invoice, not a guest booking invoice.

title: Billing — Email usage
content:
Billing — Email usage
## Email usage

The marketing email meter shows emails sent against your plan's included quota and any overage charges.

Customer chatbot reply usage is shown under [AI Usage](/ai-usage). AI and email overage belong to the platform subscription invoice. Dashboard help does not count toward the customer AI reply allowance.

title: Chat FAQ (Quick Answers) — Adding a Quick Answer
content:
Chat FAQ (Quick Answers) — Adding a Quick Answer
## Adding a Quick Answer

Choose **Add Quick Answer**, select the intent, enter a question pattern, comma-separated matching keywords and the approved answer, then save. Enabled rules can answer matching customer questions using that wording.

title: Chat FAQ (Quick Answers) — Editing and removing
content:
Chat FAQ (Quick Answers) — Editing and removing
## Editing and removing

Edit a rule to update its question, keywords, intent or answer. Toggle it off to stop using it without deleting it, or delete it with confirmation. The table shows usage count and last-used time, which help identify rules customers actually use.

title: Reports — During suspension
content:
Reports — During suspension
## During suspension

The current sign-in gate can block Reports when a subscription is paused or suspended. MAIN_ADMIN can reach Billing; contact BookingTours support if you need an export while operational access is blocked. Do not assume an export is available simply because the report itself has download controls.

title: AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — ChatGPT, MCP and Meta Muse
content:
AI usage and customer chatbot allowance — ChatGPT, MCP and Meta Muse
## ChatGPT, MCP and Meta Muse

External operator AI connections are not customer-available. A local implementation or an AI agent connections screen is not evidence that a live connection is enabled. There is no verified working live Server URL to recommend, and Meta Muse compatibility is not verified. Ask platform support about availability; do not provide connection or credential setup steps as if this feature were live.

title: Billing — Seats
content:
Billing — Seats
## Seats

Each additional admin user seat costs **R500/month**.

**Add seat** or **Remove seat** adjusts how many admin users you're paying for, with a prorated charge or credit estimate shown before you confirm. You can't remove seats below the number of admins currently active — remove the admin user first under Settings → Admin Users.

title: Customer privacy data requests — Deletion and rejection
content:
Customer privacy data requests — Deletion and rejection
## Deletion and rejection

Deletion is available only after the dashboard's cooling-off date and checks permit it. **Fulfill** permanently anonymises the customer's personal data while retaining anonymised financial records; review the confirmation carefully. **Reject** requires a reason and records the decision. These actions apply to the selected request, not every customer in the business.

title: Inbox — How bot and human handoff works
content:
Inbox — How bot and human handoff works
## How bot and human handoff works

The assistant handles routine conversations until the customer asks for a person or a handoff is needed. Sending an admin reply moves the conversation to human handling. Use **Return to Bot** when the human exchange is complete; bot replies still follow the saved mode, business hours and reply allowance. Check the returned result if handoff cannot complete.

For website conversations, **End Chat** ends the active human chat and asks the visitor to rate it. Ending a chat does not cancel a booking or process a refund.

title: Finding your way around — Suspended subscription
content:
Finding your way around — Suspended subscription
## Suspended subscription

If the subscription is PAUSED or SUSPENDED, the current sign-in gate blocks normal dashboard pages. A MAIN_ADMIN can use **Go to Billing** to reach /billing; other staff should ask their main admin. SUPER_ADMIN support access is separate. For exports or outstanding refunds that cannot be reached while blocked, contact BookingTours support instead of assuming Reports, Invoices or Refunds remain accessible.

title: Failed Notifications — Retrying
content:
Failed Notifications — Retrying
## Retrying

**Retry** attempts WhatsApp delivery immediately. If the service window is closed, the message stays queued until the customer messages again. Email retries are queued for the next notification worker run. Check whether the result says sent, queued or failed instead of assuming every retry delivered immediately.

title: Partners and combo offers
content:
Partners and combo offers
Open **Partners** in the Growth group to reach **Partners & Combos**. This area requires MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.

title: Refunds — Processing a refund
content:
Refunds — Processing a refund
## Processing a refund

For each request you can:

- **Submit refund** submits the eligible refundable card amount to Yoco. Submission can leave the booking **Refund pending**; it does not mean the customer has already received money.
- **Check status** reconciles an already pending refund with the provider. Use this to check the existing attempt rather than submitting another refund.
- **Confirm bank transfer** records a transfer you have already made outside BookingTours. It appears when a manual refund is required. Transfer and verify the money before confirming; this button does not move money from your bank.
- **Decline** rejects a requested or failed refund and notifies the customer by email. It is unavailable while a provider refund is pending or a bank transfer awaits confirmation.

Before submission, the **Refund amount** field allows a partial refund within the remaining captured balance. Pending refunds and manual-transfer confirmations have locked amounts. Review the confirmation and the returned outcome: completed, pending, manual action required, failed, unknown or not submitted. An unknown result needs reconciliation before retrying.

title: Settings — Chat FAQ (Quick Answers)
content:
Settings — Chat FAQ (Quick Answers)
## Chat FAQ (Quick Answers)

Open [AI](/ai-usage) in the Growth group, then its **Chat FAQ** tab at /settings/chat-faq. Quick Answers are not a Settings section. This page requires a main admin.

title: How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Rescheduling (rebooking)
content:
How bookings work (statuses, payments, changes) — Rescheduling (rebooking)
## Rescheduling (rebooking)

Moving a booking to a different slot or tour checks availability and the price difference. A same-price move can complete immediately. For a more expensive departure, the original booking stays in place until the customer pays the extra amount. A cheaper move can require a choice between voucher credit and a refund; follow the options shown rather than assuming money has already been returned. Customers can also use My Bookings or the customer chatbot.

Last-minute prices sell unsold seats. An existing paid booking does not automatically get that discount when rescheduling.

title: Bookings — Actions on a single booking
content:
Bookings — Actions on a single booking
## Actions on a single booking

Open a booking's action menu to:

- **Edit Booking** — change status or details. Marking a booking PAID by hand is treated as a manual payment (for example EFT or cash).
- **Rebook** — move the booking to another slot or tour. Equal-price moves can complete immediately. A more expensive slot requires payment of the difference before the move; a cheaper slot uses the available credit-voucher or refund options.
- **Refund** — start a refund for a paid booking.
- **WhatsApp** — open a conversation with the customer.
- **Resend payment link or invoice** — for unpaid bookings or when the customer lost the email.
- **Payment Reminder** — sends the existing checkout link again; send a payment link first if none exists.
- **Allow Without Payment** — keeps an unpaid reservation valid for pay on arrival and exempts it from reminders and automatic expiry. **Require Payment** restores the normal payment rules.

Open the booking's detail page to review its payment, waiver and customer notes. Marking a booking paid records money you have already received; select the actual cash, EFT, card-terminal or other payment method and add the reference where available.

title: Bookings — Exporting
content:
Bookings — Exporting
## Exporting

**Export CSV** downloads the current filtered list. There are two variants: a masked export, and a sensitive export including special requests, which is limited to MAIN_ADMIN and above and writes an audit-log entry recording who exported and when.

title: Chat FAQ (Quick Answers)
content:
Chat FAQ (Quick Answers)
Open [AI](/ai-usage) in the Growth group, then choose the **Chat FAQ** tab. The page is at /settings/chat-faq; it is not a section inside Settings or a standalone sidebar item.

Here you maintain Quick Answers for the customer WhatsApp bot and website chat. These are separate from the dashboard help assistant's product guide. Keep answers accurate and disable outdated rules.

title: Customer privacy data requests — Access exports
content:
Customer privacy data requests — Access exports
## Access exports

For a confirmed access request, **Export** creates the customer's data export and emails a download link. Generating an export is a real customer communication; review the selected request and reported result.

title: New Booking — Creating a booking
content:
New Booking — Creating a booking
## Creating a booking

1. **Activity Details** — choose the tour and number of guests. Slot Availability shows open departures; pick one.
2. **Customer Details** — name, mobile number (you'll be asked to confirm the number is correct — it's used for WhatsApp), and email.
3. **Optional Add-Ons** — extras like photo packages or equipment, with quantities; these add to the total.

Complete the custom booking questions configured for the activity and review the total before saving. Questions are maintained under Settings → Tours & Activities, not Booking Site Configuration.

title: Partners and combo offers — Partnerships
content:
Partners and combo offers — Partnerships
## Partnerships

Enter another operator's admin email and choose **Invite Partner**. Incoming invitations can be **Accepted**; an active partnership can be **Revoked**. Partner tours become available for combo setup once the partnership is active. A partnership does not give either operator unrestricted access to the other's customer records.

title: Settings — Integration Credentials
content:
Settings — Integration Credentials
## Integration Credentials

WhatsApp (access token and phone number ID), Yoco payments (live keys plus a test mode toggle), and Google Drive connection for trip photos. Credentials are encrypted at rest and can only ever be edited by MAIN_ADMIN and above — this section is never delegatable to sub-admins.

BookingTours must first connect your WhatsApp Business Account to its shared Meta app. Ask the BookingTours onboarding team to do this with you; a token from a separate Meta app will not work with the bot. The Phone Number ID is the numeric ID shown for your number in WhatsApp Manager (or in the connected app's WhatsApp API Setup), not the displayed phone number or the WhatsApp Business Account ID. For production, BookingTours generates a system-user access token for its app with `whatsapp_business_messaging` and `whatsapp_business_management` access to your account. The token displayed in API Setup is temporary and should not be saved here.

title: Dashboard home — Weather
content:
Dashboard home — Weather
## Weather

The Weather panel shows conditions for your location — useful when deciding whether to run, and pairs with the weather-cancel tools under Slots and Broadcasts.

title: Bookings — Partial arrivals and customer notes
content:
Bookings — Partial arrivals and customer notes
## Partial arrivals and customer notes

Arrival counts record how many guests in a group are actually present. [Simple View Check-ins](/simple/check-ins) lets you increase or decrease the count without marking the whole party arrived. Correcting an arrival count does not cancel the booking or refund it. Customer notes and custom-question answers stay attached to the booking for operational reference.

title: Customer privacy data requests
content:
Customer privacy data requests
Open [Settings](/settings), then **Data Requests** to reach **POPIA Data Requests**. MAIN_ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN manage these requests for the selected business. This page is excluded from the shared demo.

title: Partners and combo offers — Combo offers
content:
Partners and combo offers — Combo offers
## Combo offers

Choose **New Combo Offer**, name the offer, set its per-person price, select the participating tours and enter their shares. You can bundle your own tours without another operator, or combine your tours with an active partner's tours. Review the included activities, shares and guest timing before activating an offer.

If the page says **Combo deals are not switched on yet**, you can prepare partnerships and offers, but customers will not see combo sales until the platform enables the feature. A saved offer alone does not confirm customer availability.

title: Slots — Open, close, cancel — the difference
content:
Slots — Open, close, cancel — the difference
## Open, close, cancel — the difference

- **Close** — stops new bookings but keeps existing ones. Use when a departure is full enough or you want to pause sales.
- **Reopen** — makes a closed slot bookable again.
- **Cancel & notify** or **Weather cancel** in a slot's dialog cancels its active bookings and sends cancellation notices. Weather cancellation gives eligible paid guests reschedule, voucher or full-refund choices even at short notice. Refunds are not automatically completed by cancellation.
- **Cancel Day(s)** applies weather cancellation across selected dates. Select the date headers in the calendar first, then review the confirmation and choose **Cancel Everything**.
- **Reopen Day(s)** opens closed departures on selected dates for new bookings. Reopening a departure does not restore previously cancelled bookings.

Cancelling a whole departure or selected days uses the main-admin cancellation service and requires MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Operations staff should ask their main admin to perform it. Closing sales and editing a slot are separate actions.

title: Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Today and Calendar
content:
Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Today and Calendar
## Today and Calendar

[Today](/simple) opens **Roll call** for the current business date. Use the arrows or date picker for another day. [Calendar](/simple/calendar) also shows that selected day's booked sessions in time order. These screens show sessions with bookings, not every empty departure in the full Slots calendar.

Each session shows its time, activity, booked and arrived guests, and available places or a Full, Closed, Cancelled or Departed label. Its roll call shows each lead booker, group size, payment readiness and arrival count. Use **WhatsApp** to open a chat with the client in your own WhatsApp, or **Call** to dial their number. WhatsApp is also available on payment-recovery rows. You write and send the message yourself. A valid phone number is required; South African local numbers are converted to +27 automatically. **Check-ins** opens that session's arrival workflow; **Book** appears only when it can accept another booking.

title: Trip Photos — Sending photos
content:
Trip Photos — Sending photos
## Sending photos

1. Select a recent trip (bookings from the last 7 days, grouped by date).
2. Upload images or videos to the connected **Google Drive**, or paste photo URLs individually or as a batch separated by newlines or commas. Uploading creates a trip folder and prepares its link; it does not notify guests. Failed uploads remain selected for retry.
3. Review the gallery and choose **Send photos and thank you email**, then confirm. Photo links are saved for My Bookings and sent in the thank-you email and WhatsApp message where those contact details are available. The WhatsApp message includes the trip's links directly; there is no separate YES-reply step for identifying the trip.

A progress bar and returned results show sending status and failures per channel. WhatsApp delivery follows the normal service-window rules. The dashboard backlog counts trips without saved photo links, so it can clear after upload/link preparation before notification delivery is complete.

title: Super Admin — MFA support and sensitive settings
content:
Super Admin — MFA support and sensitive settings
## MFA support and sensitive settings

Open **MFA support and sensitive settings** at /super-admin/sensitive-actions. Select the operator first; changing its banking, WhatsApp or Yoco settings requires the signed-in Super Admin's authenticator verification. Credential status does not expose saved secret values.

For verified account recovery, select the target admin, record the identity-verification reference and acknowledge the verification before submitting. Recovery can require follow-up if it is pending or partial. This removes legacy MFA factors from the operator account. Operators use normal sign-in and do not need to enrol another authenticator. Do not choose passwords or bypass verification on the client's behalf.

title: Finding your way around — Roles and what you can see
content:
Finding your way around — Roles and what you can see
## Roles and what you can see

There are four roles, lowest to highest: OPERATOR, ADMIN, MAIN_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.

- OPERATOR and ADMIN handle day-to-day operations: bookings, inbox, slots, refunds, broadcasts and the reporting or marketing areas their main admin has left available.
- MAIN_ADMIN additionally manages Billing, AI, Chat FAQ, Partners, Data Requests, Failed Notifications, admin users and integration credentials.
- SUPER_ADMIN is platform-level and can manage all operator businesses.
- An operations admin can be granted individual Settings sections: Tours & Activities, Booking Add-Ons, External Booking, Booking Site Config, Email Customisation and Invoice Details. Booking Site Config also grants Embed Widget and Operations & AI Configuration. Integration credentials and banking details remain main-admin-only.

Main admins can hide the dashboard revenue panel, Reports, Marketing and Reviews for individual staff members. A missing page can reflect these permissions as well as the account's role.

If you can't see a page mentioned in this help, your role doesn't include it — ask your main admin.

title: Peak Pricing — Last-minute pricing
content:
Peak Pricing — Last-minute pricing
## Last-minute pricing

Time-limited last-minute deals are configured under [Settings → Tours & Activities](/settings#tours), by a main admin or staff granted Tours access. Set a deal price and its hours-before-departure window. These deals apply to eligible unsold departures; existing paid bookings do not automatically get a discount or refund by rescheduling into the deal.

title: Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Partial group arrivals
content:
Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Partial group arrivals
## Partial group arrivals

Use the minus/plus controls to set the number actually present, from zero up to the booked group size, then save. For example, record 2 of 4 arrived when half the party is present. Correct a mistaken arrival count here as well. The Today/Calendar roll-call checkbox marks the whole eligible group present or resets a fully present group; use Check-ins for precise partial counts.

title: Super Admin — Daily monitoring in plain English
content:
Super Admin — Daily monitoring in plain English
## Daily monitoring in plain English

Sentry tells you when software reports a problem. It does not replace checking that customers actually received messages or money.

1. Open [Sentry errors](https://bookingtours.sentry.io/issues/?environment=production). Select **production**, **Unresolved** and the last 24 hours.
2. Open new or repeating issues. Copy the issue link; note first/last seen, event count and tags. **app** identifies admin, booking or edge. **business_id** identifies a client when available; **function.name** identifies an edge service.
3. Prioritise payment/refund failures, sign-in failures, any wrong-client information and missed scheduled jobs. Use this page's support counts to find the affected client. Do not blindly repeat a payment, refund or message.
4. Send the issue link, client name and a plain-English description to your developer. Resolve the issue only after a deployed fix has been checked. “Regressed” means a previously resolved problem returned.

Open [Sentry monitors](https://bookingtours.sentry.io/monitors/) and check **Booking cleanup and reminders**. It should start every five minutes and report completion. A missed/failed run needs investigation even if customers have not complained.

Check the control room and Sentry at the start and end of every day, after each onboarding, and after a release. Production new/regressed-error and error-spike rules route to the platform owner's Sentry account. A test alert must actually arrive before email monitoring is considered proven.

The included cron monitor covers cleanup/reminders. Marketing functions report returned failures to Sentry, but have no separate missed-run monitor in this release. Sentry is not an independent website uptime check; if the whole site or telemetry is unavailable, inspect the hosting dashboard and public booking page.

Sources: [Sentry cron monitoring](https://docs.sentry.io/product/monitors-and-alerts/monitors/crons/), [Sentry issue triage](https://docs.sentry.io/product/issues/states-triage/), [Yoco Checkout API](https://developer.yoco.com/api-reference/checkout-api/checkout/create-checkout).

title: Settings — Invoice & Banking Details
content:
Settings — Invoice & Banking Details
## Invoice & Banking Details

Company information and EFT banking details printed on customer pro forma invoices. Staff granted **Invoice Details** can edit the permitted company fields. Banking details require MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.

title: Dashboard home — Welcome tour
content:
Dashboard home — Welcome tour
## Welcome tour

On your first login a welcome tour walks through the dashboard. Main admins also get a getting-started checklist that responds as tours, slots and bookings are created. You can replay the tour from **AI help** in the dashboard header using **Show me around the dashboard**.

title: Partners and combo offers — Settlements
content:
Partners and combo offers — Settlements
## Settlements

The settlement area lists combo amounts payable to or receivable from each partner. **Mark Settled** records a settlement already made; it does not transfer money. Add a reference or note so the record can be reconciled. Where offered, generating a settlement payment link can email the partner a checkout link; paid status updates when payment is confirmed. Review the result before assuming the partner received a link.

The [Reports](/reports) Financials tab also offers **Combo Settlements CSV** for accounting.

title: Super Admin — Monthly invoices
content:
Super Admin — Monthly invoices
## Monthly invoices

Use **Platform Invoices** for operator billing. The email usage panel is a usage/pricing view; email overage is included once in the platform invoice, not in a second customer invoice.

The preview and generated invoice share one calculation: plan, seat history, active days, email overage and AI overage. Review a draft before sending it. Generating a draft does not charge a card; sending it sends a real email and can create a payment link.

For a wrong unpaid draft without a payment link, use **Void draft**, give a reason, correct the source settings, then generate a replacement for the same month. The old document stays in **Voided history**. Paid documents are not editable or voidable here.

If a payment link exists or checkout creation started, correction is blocked until provider cancellation is verified. The Checkout API does not expose a documented cancellation operation in the reviewed API reference. Do not create a second payable invoice or delete the first to get around this protection; arrange cancellation/reconciliation with Yoco and platform support.

**Mark Paid** is for money you have actually received. Check the amount and reference in your bank first. If an old payment link has already been shared, arrange its cancellation as well so the client cannot accidentally pay twice.

title: Finding your way around — Where to find each feature
content:
Finding your way around — Where to find each feature
## Where to find each feature

- **Operations**: [Bookings](/bookings), [New Booking](/new-booking), and [Slots](/slots). Payment Reminder, Allow Without Payment and Require Payment are actions on a booking, not a separate Payment Reminders page.
- **Guest care**: [Inbox](/inbox) and [Refunds](/refunds).
- **Revenue**: [Invoices](/invoices), [Peak Pricing](/pricing), [Reports](/reports), and [Billing](/billing). Billing requires MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Reviews is a tab under Reports, at /reviews.
- **Growth**: [Marketing](/marketing), [Broadcasts](/broadcasts), [Partners](/partnerships), and [AI](/ai-usage). Partners and AI require MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Vouchers is a tab under Marketing, at /vouchers. Chat FAQ is a tab under AI, at /settings/chat-faq. Failed Notifications is a main-admin-only tab under Broadcasts, at /notifications.
- **Admin**: [Settings](/settings) and, for platform staff only, [Super Admin](/super-admin). Data Requests is reached from Settings, at /privacy/data-requests.

Use **Simple View** in the dashboard header to open the phone and tablet workflow at /simple. Use **Today** for booked sessions and arrivals, **Add walk-in** for a new booking, and **Full dashboard** to return to /.

Other direct links include [Customers](/customers), [Trip Photos](/photos) from the Dashboard's **Photo upload backlog** card, [Operators](/operators), and the [Guide app](/guide).

title: New Booking — Hold duration
content:
New Booking — Hold duration
## Hold duration

A pending manual booking holds its seats for the **Hold booking for** duration you select (default 24 hours). If payment is not received by the deadline, it can expire and release the seats. On [Bookings](/bookings), use **Allow Without Payment** for an approved pay-on-arrival exception, or **Require Payment** to restore normal expiry and reminders.

title: Slots — Peak pricing on slots
content:
Slots — Peak pricing on slots
## Peak pricing on slots

Slots carry peak flags and price overrides that are managed from the Peak Pricing page — a slot inside an active peak period shows its peak price automatically.

title: Super Admin — Before handing a client their booking link
content:
Super Admin — Before handing a client their booking link
## Before handing a client their booking link

Open **Client readiness & support** and expand their business. Automatic checks show whether the owner account, subscription, policies, activity, future availability and provider settings exist. “Saved” does not mean a payment or message worked.

Perform the six client tests and record only what you actually verified. Every confirmation has an actor and timestamp in the audit trail. The checklist is not an automatic launch approval: unresolved support problems still need attention.

If billing or policies are missing, use **Complete missing setup** once. It creates only missing records from today, preserves existing records, and does not send an invoice or take money.

**Add New Client** creates the business and Main Admin immediately. If that operator should finish the guided wizard, enter the same booking subdomain and Main Admin email under **Onboarding Invites**. The invite attaches to the existing business; it does not create a second one. The booking site pauses until the operator completes the wizard. Businesses with bookings cannot use this handoff; their owners finish setup in the admin dashboard. For a new operator, you can start directly with **Onboarding Invites**, which creates a fenced skeleton business. A retried assisted submission uses the same request ID to avoid duplicates.

In **Business Management**, an operator still marked **ONBOARDING** has an **Activate operator** action. Complete missing setup under **Client readiness & support**, check launch readiness, then activate and record a reason. This changes the operator and its subscription to **ACTIVE**, enables online bookings, and records the change in the audit trail. It does not complete the guided wizard or send the owner a password setup email; use **Send setup link** if needed.

title: Super Admin — Support and staff access
content:
Super Admin — Support and staff access
## Support and staff access

Select the client before opening their settings, billing, privacy requests or notifications. The server verifies the selected business against your sign-in; ordinary clients cannot switch into another business by editing a request.

In the client's detail panel, **Send setup link** emails a secure password link. Let the owner choose their password. **Suspend** blocks staff access and revokes refresh sessions without deleting records. **Reactivate** requires an available seat. You cannot suspend yourself, another platform account, or the last active Main Admin. Increase seats or promote another active Main Admin first, as appropriate.

Business suspension requires confirmation and an audit reason. It stops trading and is not automatically lifted just because an invoice is paid. Pausing/resuming billing and changing seats update billing records atomically. Seat reductions cannot fall below active staff.

title: Reports — Filtering and exporting
content:
Reports — Filtering and exporting
## Filtering and exporting

Filter the booking-based reports by date range, and choose whether the range applies to the **tour date** or the **booking date** — revenue by trip day and revenue by sale day are different views, pick the one your accountant wants. Export the filtered data as **CSV** (for spreadsheets) or **PDF**. Reviews uses status filters instead of date ranges and exports.

title: Simple View, roll call and check-ins
content:
Simple View, roll call and check-ins
Choose **Simple View** in the full dashboard's header for the phone and tablet operations workflow. Its navigation has **Today**, **Add walk-in** and **Full dashboard**. **Full dashboard** returns to / for scheduling, refunds, marketing and configuration.

title: Bookings — Returning guests
content:
Bookings — Returning guests
## Returning guests

Expand a departure to see each guest's booking history. **Welcome back** shows the previous paid/completed booking date and the number of earlier paid bookings, excluding the booking being viewed. History matches saved email addresses or phone numbers within your own business. Failed, pending and cancelled bookings do not count. Returning guests also receive a welcome-back greeting in their booking confirmation email.

Configure repeat-booking, return-time and group-size offers under [Marketing → Promotions](/marketing/promotions).

title: Marketing — Templates and campaigns
content:
Marketing — Templates and campaigns
## Templates and campaigns

Design reusable email templates under Marketing → Templates and preview them before preparing a campaign. Promotional test sends and campaign delivery remain unavailable until the delivery controls and permission evidence are ready. A scheduled campaign can be **cancelled** and a sending campaign **paused** from Recent Campaigns on the overview. These controls stop remaining sends; emails already delivered cannot be recalled.

title: Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Payment and waiver readiness
content:
Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Payment and waiver readiness
## Payment and waiver readiness

[Check-ins](/simple/check-ins) shows the payment and waiver status before recording arrivals. If money has actually been received offline, choose **Cash**, **EFT**, **Card (terminal)** or **Other**, add a payment note or reference, and record it. Wait for the refreshed booking to confirm payment. A pay-on-arrival exception alone is not a recorded payment.

A signed waiver and settled payment are required before adding arrivals. An admin may explicitly approve an account or reseller arrival with a reference and reason; the waiver is still required. Allow Without Payment alone is not this approval. Check the displayed blocking reason if the control is unavailable. Recording a payment does not collect a card payment through Yoco.

title: Marketing — Automatic chat booking offers
content:
Marketing — Automatic chat booking offers
## Automatic chat booking offers

[Promotions](/marketing/promotions) includes **Automatic chat discounts**. Set the bookings required within a number of days, days since the last paid booking, and minimum/maximum group sizes. Add rules for different thresholds, choose a whole percentage from 0 to 100, or disable a rule. All configured conditions on a rule must match. Only paid and completed bookings count; the largest matching offer applies, without stacking automatic discounts. WhatsApp and web chat use the same saved rules and recheck them before checkout. Returning-guest offers are checked using the supplied phone number. Website checkout promo codes remain separate.

Choose **Add discount rule**, select **Bookings within a period**, **Time since last booking** or **Group size** under **Qualify by**, enter the thresholds and discount, enable the rule, then select **Save automatic discounts**. Saving an offer changes WhatsApp and web chat's eligibility rules for new quotes; it does not send an unsolicited promotional message.

title: Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Following up a failed Yoco payment
content:
Payment reminders and unpaid bookings — Following up a failed Yoco payment
## Following up a failed Yoco payment

The **Payment recovery** panel on the Dashboard and Simple View lists failed booking payments reported by Yoco. **Needs payment** shows outstanding bookings. **Email payment link** sends the guest an email explaining that their payment was rejected or could not be completed, with their secure Yoco checkout link. The panel records when the email service accepts the email; this is not a delivery receipt.

The action checks availability and renews the booking's seat hold for up to 24 hours, ending at least an hour before departure. Missing contact details, unavailable seats, or expired voucher funding must be reviewed in the booking first. Cancelled and paid bookings cannot receive recovery emails.

When Yoco confirms successful payment, the booking leaves **Needs payment** and appears as **Paid** under **All outcomes**. The panel refreshes automatically; **Refresh** checks immediately. A duplicate or delayed failure event cannot turn a paid booking back into an unpaid booking.

title: Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Walk-ins and the shared demo
content:
Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Walk-ins and the shared demo
## Walk-ins and the shared demo

Choose **Add walk-in** in the header or **Book** on an available session. The form at /simple/new-booking carries the selected date or departure and returns to the appropriate screen after saving. Review the adult/child counts, extras, payment action and any required booking or participant questions before choosing Create. Draft details survive Back and Cancel within the same authenticated browser tab. Capacity and normal booking checks still apply.

The shared demo explains operations without committing payments, arrivals or new bookings. Use the full dashboard's AI bot for its product tour.

title: Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Guide-only access
content:
Simple View, roll call and check-ins — Guide-only access
## Guide-only access

Guides use the operator's shared `guide@operator-name` login and chosen password. This opens [Guide Simple View](/simpleguide) directly, with the roll call, client contact links, expected passenger counts and check-ins for the selected day. Use the date arrows/date picker and **Refresh day** to update it. **Trip photos** opens the same Photos workspace as the main dashboard, preselected for that departure. Guides can upload images/videos, paste or bulk-import links, review recent photo links, and confirm **Send photos and thank you email** to notify that trip's lead bookers.
