Access is limited to the guide's operator; Full dashboard, walk-ins, payment recording and marketing campaigns remain unavailable.

The operator owner sets up this login in [Settings → Admin Users → Guide login](/settings#admins), chooses **Create guide login**, and privately shares the one-use password setup link. It expires after 48 hours. A guide chooses the shared password once and is signed directly into Simple View. After that, all guides use the shared username and password on the normal sign-in screen. The owner can disable access or issue a fresh setup link when the password is forgotten. Shared guides can send trip photos and the existing thank-you email for their own operator's trips.

title: Settings — Tours & Activities
content:
Settings — Tours & Activities
## Tours & Activities

Create and edit tours, descriptions, duration, departure schedules, default capacity, base and peak prices, images and confirmation taglines. Drag to reorder the booking-site cards. Activate/deactivate and show/hide control sales and public visibility; neither action cancels existing bookings. Tours with booking history or linked active vouchers cannot be deleted.

Departure times use a **24-hour clock** in the operator’s saved timezone (SAST for South Africa). Type **1800** continuously to enter **18:00**, or **0930** for **09:30**, without selecting AM/PM. For a **2-hour, 30-minute** tour, select **hours**, enter **2**, and enter **30** in the adjacent minutes field. Existing durations load into the matching hours and minutes when edited; whole-day tours still support **days**.

When generating slots, choose **Date range** for a repeating weekday schedule or **Specific dates** to pick individual tour dates. Add as many dates and departure times as needed. Each departure time is created on every selected date, and existing departures are skipped. For a new tour, the selected schedule is generated when you choose **Add Tour**; for an existing tour, choose **Generate Slots**.

**Last-minute deals** have a deal price and a start/end window measured in hours before departure. They apply to eligible unsold availability, not refunds on an existing paid booking. Upcoming departure-time bundles can also be managed here; [Slots](/slots) has the full calendar and bulk tools.

**Custom Booking Questions** is in [Tours & Activities](/settings#tours). Add a template or a question, choose its answer type, options and required status, then save. The answers are captured with the booking and shown to staff; these questions are not in Booking Site Configuration.

title: New Booking — Taking payment
content:
New Booking — Taking payment
## Taking payment

Choose **Payment action**:

- **Request payment** sends the customer a payment request; money is still due until payment is confirmed.
- **Hold places, no immediate message** reserves places until the hold deadline without an immediate notification.
- **Confirm booking, money still due** confirms the reservation without recording a payment. Check-in still requires payment and a signed waiver, or an explicit account/reseller approval plus the waiver.
- **Record payment already received** records money actually collected, with its method and reference. It does not charge a card through Yoco.

Use **Review booking** to check the selected departure, adult/child counts, extras, required participant answers and final total, then **Create Booking**. The receipt distinguishes total, paid and due amounts and reports the notification result. A lost response is not proof that saving failed; use the save reference to inspect the booking before starting another one.

title: New Booking — Walk-ins from Simple View
content:
New Booking — Walk-ins from Simple View
## Walk-ins from Simple View

Use **Add walk-in** in Simple View, or **Book** on an available session, to open /simple/new-booking. The form uses the selected date or departure where provided and can return to the original Simple View screen after saving. A full or closed departure cannot accept an additional booking.

title: Dashboard home — Failed payment follow-up
content:
Dashboard home — Failed payment follow-up
## Failed payment follow-up

**Payment recovery** on the Dashboard and operator Simple View lists failed booking payments reported by Yoco. Under **Needs payment**, use **Email payment link** to send a rejection explanation and secure Yoco checkout link. Availability and booking checks still apply. After Yoco confirms payment, the booking leaves Needs payment and shows **Paid** under **All outcomes**. Use **Refresh** for the latest result. The email's sent time records service acceptance, not a delivery receipt. Shared guide logins cannot use this panel.

For a direct client conversation, **WhatsApp** in Simple View's roll-call and payment-recovery rows opens your own WhatsApp. You write and send the message yourself.

title: Dashboard home — Dashboard assistant and guest chatbot
content:
Dashboard home — Dashboard assistant and guest chatbot
## Dashboard assistant and guest chatbot

The dashboard assistant explains where features are and how to use them. It uses the platform guide, not your live business records, so open the relevant page to read current totals or inspect a booking. In the live dashboard it can open pages and fill supported voucher or slot fields using values you provide. In the shared demo it explains actions and opens included pages without saving changes.

The customer website and WhatsApp chatbot is configured separately under Settings → Operations & AI Configuration and AI → Chat FAQ. Dashboard help is not billed against the customer chatbot's reply allowance.

title: Settings — Saving banking and integration settings
content:
Settings — Saving banking and integration settings
## Saving banking and integration settings

Operator accounts use their normal sign-in to save banking details, WhatsApp credentials, Yoco credentials and Yoco test mode. No authenticator setup or code is required. Existing role permissions still apply: these settings are managed by the account owner (MAIN_ADMIN). Platform Super Admins still verify their own authenticator when changing these settings.

title: Settings — Data Requests and unavailable connections
content:
Settings — Data Requests and unavailable connections
## Data Requests and unavailable connections

Main admins reach [Data Requests](/privacy/data-requests) from the link at the bottom of Settings. OTA Channels currently says direct Viator and GetYourGuide connections are not available yet. Do not try to configure them as live integrations. Operator ChatGPT/MCP and Meta Muse connections are also not customer-available; they are separate from the built-in dashboard and guest assistants.

title: Marketing — Sending quota
content:
Marketing — Sending quota
## Sending quota

Email sending draws from your plan's monthly included quota; the usage meter warns before you go into overage. Details of your plan are on the Billing page.

title: Marketing — Welcome-back email sequences
content:
Marketing — Welcome-back email sequences
## Welcome-back email sequences

In [Automations](/marketing/automations), use **Welcome-back email sequence** or select **Welcome back — time since last booking** in the builder. Set **Days since last paid booking**, then edit the email templates, delays and optional promo-code steps. The starter draft describes a percentage promo code rather than a cash voucher. Save and preview the draft. Automatic welcome-back delivery and promo issuance remain held while the event and delivery controls are completed; the draft cannot be activated yet.

These sequences use the last paid/completed booking date, not signup date. The configured sequence is based on one last-booking date per cycle and checks for rebooking, unsubscribe and upcoming reservations. It does not send while held. Legacy promotional WhatsApp win-back messages are also held. Transactional booking and payment emails continue separately.

title: Marketing — Automations
content:
Marketing — Automations
## Automations

In **Automations → Suggested email sequences**, choose **Ask for reviews**, **Welcome new enquiries** or **Invite customers back**, then **Preview sequence** to see the emails and timing before creating a draft. The count shows matching contacts, not emails sent or an active automation. The initial Invite customers back count uses 90 days since the last paid booking; adjust timing in the saved draft. **Voucher expiry reminders** are listed here as unavailable. **View vouchers** opens the voucher list for manual review.

Under Marketing → Automations you can draft triggered emails, for example a message a number of days before or after a booking date, birthday offers, or win-back campaigns. Browse Templates for ready-made flows (welcome series, post-tour review requests, win-back campaigns and more) that come with designed emails already linked, or start from scratch. Draft steps can include one-off vouchers or promo codes, but automatic issuance and promotional delivery remain held.

Every step in a workflow is shown as a plain sentence (for example "Immediately: send Welcome Email" or "Wait 3 days") instead of raw configuration, consistently on the editor, the automations list, and the template gallery preview. Click a Send Email step's **Edit details** to change its settings, or **Preview** to see the actual email that will go out.

New automations start as drafts. Review the linked emails and trigger in the editor. Activation and promotional test sends are currently unavailable; existing journeys can be paused. Audience, overlap, timing and send-volume estimates are shown as unavailable when they cannot be verified.

title: Marketing — Setting up email sending
content:
Marketing — Setting up email sending
## Setting up email sending

Marketing checks email setup for the selected operator. **Marketing emails need setup** lists the remaining work for BookingTours: the email connection, bounced-email and spam reports, the operator’s local time zone if missing, and enabling sending for the operator. **Email BookingTours** opens a support email with the operator and current setup steps; review and send it yourself. **Review contacts** opens customer permission records. You can still save and preview drafts.

Automatic welcome-back emails remain unavailable while the booking-based delivery work is completed, even when email settings are configured. Configured credentials are not proof that sending has been tested. If setup cannot be checked, choose **Check again**; the dashboard does not assume your setup is incomplete.

Select **Review contacts** to open the contact list. A contact who needs permission checked does not yet have a confirmed record of agreeing to marketing emails. Adding or importing their email address is not enough. Ask BookingTours to review the original signup or permission record; do not change an unsubscribed contact back to active to bypass this check.

title: Guide access and the Guide app — Shared guide login for Simple View
content:
Guide access and the Guide app — Shared guide login for Simple View
## Shared guide login for Simple View

The operator owner (MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN) creates **Guide login** under [Settings → Admin Users](/settings#admins). There is one shared login per operator, such as `guide@cape-kayak`, based on the operator's subdomain. The login stays the same if the operator later renames the subdomain. Ordinary dashboard staff must ask their main admin to manage this access.

Choose **Create guide login**, copy the private password setup link and share it with your guides. The guide follows the link and chooses a password of at least eight characters. The link expires after 48 hours and works once. Password setup signs the guide straight into Simple View. Afterwards they use the same shared login and chosen password on the normal sign-in screen.

Guides see the same roll-call layout as admin Simple View, with each client's name, group size, phone number and email on their operator's selected day. **Call**, **WhatsApp** and email links open the client's contact details. Use the date arrows/date picker and **Refresh day** to check another day or update the roster. Mark a group present from Roll call, or open **Check-ins** to enter or correct partial arrivals. Payment and signed-waiver checks still apply; ask the operator to resolve a blocked booking. **Trip photos** opens the same Photos workspace used by the main dashboard at /guide/photos/<departure-id>, inside the simple-view layout. It includes images/videos, individual and bulk photo links, recent galleries and **Send photos and thank you email**. After confirmation, the trip's lead bookers receive the same photo/thank-you email and WhatsApp photo message as the main Photos page. Uploads use the operator's existing Google Drive connection. The shared login has no office dashboard, booking creation, payment recording, marketing or customer-email campaign controls. It cannot access another operator's trips.

The owner can disable guide access here. **Get fresh password setup link** replaces the previous link and requires the shared password to be set again. No password is displayed to the owner and no setup email is automatically sent to the guide username. Share setup links privately.

If the link expires or the shared password is forgotten, ask the owner for a fresh link. If access is disabled, ask the owner to enable it. Never paste a password or private setup link into AI help.

title: Trip Photos — Photos through the shared guide login
content:
Trip Photos — Photos through the shared guide login
## Photos through the shared guide login

Guides signed in as `guide@operator-name` choose **Trip photos** from a departure in [Guide Simple View](/simpleguide). This opens the same Photos workspace as the main dashboard, with that departure selected. Guides can choose recent trips, upload images and videos to the operator's connected Google Drive, add or bulk-import photo links, review recent photo links, and choose **Send photos and thank you email**. Confirming sends the same photo/thank-you email and WhatsApp photo message to the trip's eligible lead bookers, using the operator's existing templates and contact details. Uploading alone does not notify guests.

Failed uploads remain selected for retry; earlier successful folder links are retained. Partial message failures remain visible so the guide can correct them before another send. Trip selection clears the previous trip's editable links. Guides can only view, upload and send for their own operator; they cannot connect/disconnect Drive, choose arbitrary recipients or open office/marketing settings. If Google Drive is disconnected, paste photo links or ask the main admin to connect it in Settings.

title: Settings — Shared Guide login
content:
Settings — Shared Guide login
## Shared Guide login

Under **Admin Users → Guide login**, a MAIN_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN selects **Create guide login**, then copies and privately shares the one-use password setup link. It expires after 48 hours. A guide opens it and chooses the shared password; there is no automatic setup email to the guide alias. One `guide@operator-name` login serves all guides for this operator, based on its subdomain, and stays the same after a subdomain rename.

After setup, guides use that username and password on the normal sign-in screen and go directly to [Guide Simple View](/simpleguide). The roll call shows expected passenger totals, client contact links and check-ins. **Trip photos** on a departure opens the same Photos workspace as the full dashboard: image/video uploads through the operator's connected Google Drive, individual or bulk photo links, recent galleries, and **Send photos and thank you email**. Confirming sends the existing photo/thank-you email and WhatsApp photo message to eligible lead bookers for that trip. Guides cannot open office or marketing settings, create bookings, record payments, change the Drive connection or choose arbitrary recipients. This is separate from adding an ordinary dashboard admin and from the existing /guide check-in app.

Use **Disable guide access** or **Enable guide access** to change availability. **Get fresh password setup link** replaces the prior link and requires the shared password to be set again, including when it is forgotten. Do not ask guides to share passwords or private setup tokens in chat.
